The Exotic Animals Front is one of the first illegal operations most players find. Behind the Three Sheets Liquor Store in Key Lento a smuggling ring keeps exotic birds, and one parrot keeps hinting at a stash of money.

Most players trigger it while doing a side mission for Jason's neighbor Shirley in GTA 6 Chapter 1, when she sends you to buy rum.

Once the guards are down, follow what the parrot says and look at the generator room.

Open the vent and you'll find a cash stash of $1,263.

After that, the operation marker disappears from your map for good.
